findings.title: Golden retained-document coverage exercises only rename, not add/connect/delete
findings.why_it_matters: The lossless path has distinct serializer branches for attaching newly created elements/connections and detaching deleted semantics from a freshly reparsed retained moddle graph. The new fixture invokes only updateElement with a name change, so a regression in createElement, connect, deleteElement, attachElement, attachConnection, detachSemantic, or retained DI reconciliation can discard the fixture's extensions, lane membership, collaboration/message reference, labels, or unrelated DI while every focused test stays green.
findings.suggested_fix: Add table-driven golden cases that import full-semantics-di.bpmn, then (1) create a new unrelated task with distinctive bounds, (2) connect it with a new flow, and (3) delete an existing targeted node/flow. Parse each export with bpmn-moddle, assert the intended semantic/DI delta, and compare the remaining moddle graph against the original after removing only that expected delta.
evidence: tests/integration/import-roundtrip.test.ts:45-69 performs exactly one mutation: updateElement(..., { name: 'Reviewed request' }); none of its three cases call createElement, connect, or deleteElement on the rich fixture.

src/core/BpmnDocument.ts:482-506 takes independent isNew attachment branches for elements and connections, while lines 418-429 and 520-530 remove stale retained semantics for deletions; those branches are required specifically when editing an imported sourceXml document.

The only imported delete coverage found is tests/unit/core/SimpleBpmnEngine.test.ts:746-763, which imports XML generated by this engine and therefore has no retained lane, extension, condition, message reference, DI label, or custom-namespace semantics from the new golden fixture.

residual_risks: The rich fixture is not re-opened from its autosaved file in a fresh engine before mutation; existing two-pool coverage exercises loadDiagram/update but does not cover the fixture's extensions, conditional flow, labels, or nested DI.

The golden mutation changes only name, so retained property synchronization for event definitions, boundary attachments, call activities, and text annotations is not demonstrated against imported BPMN.
testing_gaps: Exercise createElement, connect, and deleteElement after importing full-semantics-di.bpmn, asserting both the expected change and canonical preservation of every unrelated semantic and DI object.
Persist the rich fixture, load it in a fresh SimpleBpmnEngine, apply a targeted edit, and repeat the canonical preservation assertions.
Add focused retained-property mutation cases for supported imported event, attachment, call-activity, and text-annotation properties.
